children: Navin kumar moves to pantnagar after serving as factory head hr at nestlé india’s tahliwal factory

Nestlé India has appointed Navin Kumar as Factory Head HR at its Pantnagar factory in Uttarakhand. Kumar takes charge of the role in October 2026 after serving as Factory Head HR at the company’s Tahliwal factory since April 2025. He brings more than 18 years of HR experience across manufacturing and FMCG.

Kumar will lead HR responsibilities at Nestlé India’s Pantnagar factory, one of the company’s large manufacturing locations in India. His appointment marks a continuation of his HR leadership career within Nestlé, following his 18-month stint at the Tahliwal factory.

During his tenure at Tahliwal, Kumar worked on employee relations and union consultation, while also driving digital initiatives. His experience at Nestlé followed a long career in the core manufacturing sector.
Before joining Nestlé, Kumar spent nearly 16 years at Tata Steel in a series of HR roles across its operations.

His most recent position there was Head HRBP for the Bearings Division, based in Kharagpur. Earlier, he served as Head HRBP for Shared Services TSJ in Jamshedpur and held HR leadership roles covering iron making, the CWR cell and the Noamundi OMQ Division.

Kumar also held senior HRM positions covering corporate functions, shared services and employee amenities. Earlier in his Tata Steel career, he worked as Manager HR/IR across the Jharia and OMQ divisions.
Kumar began his professional career at ACC, where he worked as Assistant Manager-HR & EW from June 2008 to June 2009.
His career has therefore covered HR roles across cement, mining, metals and FMCG, giving him experience across different manufacturing environments and employee groups.

Kumar’s professional experience includes employee relations, HR business partnering, talent management and workplace diversity and inclusion. His profile also highlights an interest in talent development and building more diverse workplaces.
He holds a PGDPM&IR in Personnel Management from the Xavier Institute of Social Service, where he graduated with First Class with Distinction.
Kumar’s move to Pantnagar adds another manufacturing HR leadership role to his career as he takes on responsibilities at Nestlé India’s Uttarakhand facility.
